boracay.name: Boracay
boracay.short_description: Baybay a maputi so buhangin tan makulay so biang labi ed saray pinakambelat a isla ed mundo.
boracay.content: Saray Boracay so arum ed pinakakilalaan a pasyalan ed Filipinas, tan masansan a mailista ed saray pinakambelat a isla ed mundo. Say White Beach so pinakabantog a yaman to, ya apat a kilometro so kaatagey na masustansya a buhangin tan malinaw a malinaw a danum. Ag-abay na panpahingalo ed baybay, saray Boracay et mangiter met na parasailing, kiteboarding, scuba diving, tan panaglayag ed paraw ed paglubog na agew.
highlights: Panaglayag ed paraw ed paglubog na agew
Saray paligsan ed danum tan panag-diving
travel_tips: Magpareserba na panag-iyan a maaga no matalem so bisita
Sundon so lokal a saray paglinteg parad panangaywan ed kalikasan tan panag-akses ed baybay
Subukan so panaglibot ed saray abay a isla tan cove
Usaren so tricycle parad saray abeba a biyahe ed palibot na isla

el-nido.name: Palawan (El Nido)
el-nido.short_description: Matayag a saray bangin a apog, nailemmeng a laguna, tan bantog a panaglibot ed saray isla.
el-nido.content: Say El Nido et mangengganyo ed saray matayag a bangin a apog tan nailemmeng a laguna ya mabalin a liboten na kayak o langoyan ed berde tan malinaw a danum. Kaiba ed Palawan, ya masansan a tawagen a Huling Pabpaway, say El Nido so saray pinakaberdeng a pasyalan ed panagbiyahe ed Southeast Asia, ya walaan na mabiskeg a tanaway a karst tan malinaw a laguna.
highlights: Saray tour ed panaglibot ed isla
travel_tips: Makisaray ed organisado a Tour A/B/C/D parad panag-akses ed laguna
Mangiyakar na sunscreen ya ligtas ed coral reef
Makatulong so kwarta ed saray melag a negosyo
Mangila ed 3-4 agew pian nasayaat a nasiyasat so lugar

coron.name: Palawan (Coron)
coron.short_description: Malinis a saray danum, laguna, tan bantog a saray lugar na panag-diving ed saray nalunod a barko.
coron.content: Say Coron et bantog ed interon mundo lapud saray marakep a danum, laguna, tan saray lugar na panag-diving. Masansan a tawagen so Kayangan Lake bilang pinakanlinis a danum ed Asia, ya napalibotan na matayag a bangin a apog. Para ed saray manag-diving, saray barko na Ikadua a Gera Mundial et ag-iyan ed leksab na dayat tan nagbalin a coral-encrusted a saray lugar na panag-diving.
highlights: Panag-diving ed saray nalunod a barko na Ikadua a Gera Mundial
travel_tips: Bayaran so environmental fee ed opisina na turismo
Magpareserba na dive shop a maaga no matalem so bisita
Mangrugi na saray tour ed isla a maaga pian likayan so kadakelan na totoo
Manlapud ed Busuanga Airport, sakay na van pasingger ed baley na Coron

cebu.name: Cebu
cebu.short_description: Kasaritaan, canyoneering, tan say Reina a Siyudad na Habagat.
cebu.content: Say Cebu et mangkombina na kasaysayan, biang na siyudad, tan adventure ed luwar. Ed Cebu City, saray landmark a singa Magellan's Cross tan Basilica Minore del Santo Niño et mangipapanengneng na saray Espanyol a tawir na isla. Para ed saray mankakalikasan, say Kawasan Falls ed Badian et bantog lapud canyoneering ed saray turquoise a danum.
travel_tips: Manlapud ed Mactan-Cebu International Airport
Magpareserba na canyoneering tour ed saray lisensyado a guide
Kombinaren so panaglakbay ed saray makasaysayan a lugar na siyudad tan saray biyahe ed abagatan na Cebu
Subukan so lechon tan pinatuyo a mangga

bohol.name: Bohol
bohol.short_description: Chocolate Hills, tarsier, tan maputi a saray baybay ed Panglao.
bohol.content: Bantog so Bohol lapud saray pambihira a likas tan kultural a yaman to. Say Chocolate Hills et napakaliket a tanaway na labi 1,200 a burol ya tinawyan na dagem. Say tarsier na Filipinas, melag a primate ya walaan na marakep a matan, et pinalikel ed lokal a saray santuwaryo. Say Panglao Island et walaan na resort tan saray akses ed diving parad coral reef.
travel_tips: Mag-abang na motor o makisaray ed tour ed kabukiran parad saray burol tan simbale
Bisitaen la iray tarsier ed saray akreditado a santuwaryo
Saray fast ferry et mangkokonekta ed Cebu tan Bohol ed agnas 2 oras
Kombinaren so tour ed burol ed pananginmuran ed ilog

siargao.name: Siargao
siargao.short_description: Kapitolyo na surfing ya walaan na laguna, isla, tan natalna a biang ed isla.
siargao.content: Bilang Kapitolyo na Surfing na Filipinas, say Siargao et mangawit na saray surfer a manlapud interon mundo ed Cloud 9. Ag-abay na saray balod, say Magpupungko Rock Pools tan Sugba Lagoon et mangiter na panaglangoy tan paddleboarding ya napalibotan na bakawan.
travel_tips: Mag-abang na scooter pian liboten so isla
Magpareserba na biyahe ed bangka pasingger ed Sohoton a maaga
Irespeto so lokal a palatuntunan ed panag-ila ed surfing
Malawak so gamit na cash tan e-wallet
siargao.best_time_to_visit: Agosto-Nobyembre parad surfing; Marso-Mayo parad natalna a danum

baguio.name: Baguio
baguio.short_description: Nalamig a panagpahingalo ed kabukiran tan Kapitolyo na Panawen na Init na Filipinas.
baguio.content: A tawagen a Kapitolyo na Panawen na Init na Filipinas, say Baguio et natalna a panagpahingalo ed kabukiran ya walaan na nalamig a klima, saray burol ya tinawyan na pine, tan makulay a kultura. Say Burnham Park, Strawberry Farm ed La Trinidad, tan Session Road et mangipaliwanag na biang na siyudad.
travel_tips: Mangiyakar na malaka a jacket maski panawen na init
Subukan so ube jam tan lokal a kape
Mabiskeg so trapiko na weekend manlapud Manila
Bisitaen so Tam-awan Village parad arte na Cordillera
baguio.best_time_to_visit: Pebrero parad Panagbenga o Marso-Mayo parad pinakanalamig a panawen

vigan.name: Vigan
vigan.short_description: Siyudad a tawir na UNESCO na saray bato a dalan tan Espanyol a kolonyal a alindog.
vigan.content: Bilang UNESCO World Heritage Site, say Vigan et mangiyakar ed saray bisita ed panahon na kolonyal a Espanya. Say Calle Crisologo et napalibotan na saray daan a abung, dalan a bato, tan saray kalesa ya magilaw ed malagong a ilaw na parol no labi.
travel_tips: Man-iyan na sankalabi pian natey so Calle Crisologo a makailaw no labi
Subukan so empanada tan longganisa ed Plaza Burgos
Kombinaren ed Pagudpud o Banaue ed saray biyahe ed norte na Luzon
Mansuot na komportable a sapatos parad saray dalan a bato

banaue-rice-terraces.name: Saray Hagdan-hagdan a Palayan na Banaue
banaue-rice-terraces.short_description: Daan a saray hagdan-hagdan a palayan ya inukit ed kabukiran - pakakakel a milagro na UNESCO.
banaue-rice-terraces.content: Saray Hagdan-hagdan a Palayan na Banaue, ya masansan a tawagen a Kawalo a Milagro na Mundo, et inukit ed kabukiran ed labi 2,000 taon. Saray mas nailemmeng a palayan na Batad, ya walay porma na ampiteatro, et man-ani ni labat na saray komunidad na Ifugao.
highlights: Saray Hagdan-hagdan a Palayan na Batad
Saray baryo a tawir na Ifugao
travel_tips: Mag-abang na lokal a guide parad saray panagtrek ed Batad
Saray bus ed labi et manbiyahe manlapud Manila (9-10 oras)
Mansuot na mabiskeg a sapatos - matarik tan maputik so saray dalan
Irespeto so saray komunidad na magsasaka tan saray limitasyon na palayan
banaue-rice-terraces.best_time_to_visit: Disyembre anggad Mayo parad panagtrek; panawen na anien parad saray tanaway a bulawan

chocolate-hills.name: Chocolate Hills
chocolate-hills.short_description: Labi 1,000 a pambihira a burol ya pormaan na dome ya nagbabrown no panawen na namaga.
chocolate-hills.content: Say Chocolate Hills et geolohikal a pormasyon na labi 1,000 a burol ya tinawyan na dagem ya nagbabrown a singa tsokolate no panawen na namaga, ya mamakurang na saray pinakakilalaan a tanaway ed Filipinas.
highlights: Saray abay a santuwaryo na tarsier
travel_tips: Bisitaen na kaaraw pian mas malinaw so tanaway
Kombinaren ed interon tour ed kabukiran na Bohol
Mangiyakar na panagprotekta ed agew - nabuklat so tanaway
Kombinaren ed Panglao parad panagpahingalo ed baybay

camiguin.name: Camiguin
camiguin.short_description: Isla na bulkan, maiinit a saray bukal, talon, tan Sunken Cemetery.
camiguin.content: A tawagen a Isla ya Liniknaan na Apoy, say Camiguin et walaan na bulkan, maiinit a bukal, tan makapaliket a Sunken Cemetery ya markado na dakel a krus ya bumangat manlapud dayat. Say White Island sandbar et mangiter na malawak a tanaway ed Mount Hibok-Hibok.
travel_tips: Mag-abang na multicab o motor pian liboten so isla
Siyasaten so paniempo antis na panagbiyahe ed bangka pasingger ed White Island
Subukan so lanzones no panawen to
Mabiskeg so biyahe ed eroplano o ferry manlapud Cagayan de Oro
camiguin.best_time_to_visit: Marso-Mayo o Oktubre parad Pista na Lanzones

davao.name: Davao
davao.short_description: Pasingger ed Mt. Apo, saray agila na Filipinas, tan kultural a puso na Mindanao.
davao.content: Say Davao City so pinakadakel a siyudad ed Mindanao, ya mangkombina na panag-unlad na siyudad tan likas a saray milagro. Say Davao so dalan pasingger ed Mount Apo, say katayagan a bundok na bansa, tan say Philippine Eagle Center et mangaywan ed nanganganib a pambansan a manok.
highlights: Saray pamilian na durian tan seafood
travel_tips: Manlipad pasingger ed Davao International Airport
Siyasaten so saray travel advisory parad panagtrek ed bundok
Subukan so durian, pomelo, tan inihaw a tuna
Abeba la so panagbiyahe ed ferry pasingger ed Samal Island
davao.location: Davao City tan saray abay to
davao.best_time_to_visit: Marso parad Araw ng Dabaw o Agosto parad Pista na Kadayawan

sagada.name: Sagada
sagada.short_description: Nalamig a baley ed kabukiran ya walaan na kweba, talon, tan saray kabaong ya nakabitay.
sagada.content: Say Sagada et bantog lapud nalamig a klima, maong a saray tradisyon na Igorot, tan marakep a saray tanaway. Saray Hanging Coffins ed Echo Valley et mangipapanengneng na saray kaugalian ed panaon na panaglibing. Say Sumaguing Cave tan Bomod-ok Falls et mangiter na gantimpala ed saray bisita ya guston adventure.
travel_tips: Mag-abang na guide ed kweba - obligasyon parad Sumaguing
Nalamig saray labi; mangiyakar na saray layer a bado
Agnas 5 oras so bus manlapud Baguio
Irespeto so saray sagrado a lugar na panaglibing tan lokal a kaugalian

mayon-volcano.name: Mayon Volcano
mayon-volcano.short_description: Bulkan ya perpekto so porma na kono, panag-atv, saray rurok, tan adventure a tanaway.
mayon-volcano.content: Bantog so Mayon Volcano lapud say porma na kono et kasla perpekto. Adayaw na saray bisita so kagandahan to ed Cagsawa Ruins, ya saray labi na simbale et mananap ed panangipalagip ed panagbulos na 1814. Saray panag-atv ed sakey na bulkan et mangiter na adventure ed eksperience.
highlights: Saray whale shark ed Donsol (panawen la)
travel_tips: Manlipad ed Legazpi parad pinakabiskeg a akses
Agpadepende ed paniempo so tanaway - mangila na dagdag a agew
Subukan so Bicol Express tan laing
Kombinaren ed Donsol no panawen na whale shark

kawasan-falls.name: Cebu (Kawasan Falls)
kawasan-falls.short_description: Turquoise a saray talon tan bantog a saray adventure na canyoneering.
kawasan-falls.content: Bantog so Kawasan Falls lapud canyoneering ed turquoise a saray danum tan agdadalusdos a danum. Saray talon ya walay arum a antas et kaiba ed saray pinakanaretratoan a likas a atraksyon ed Cebu tan marakep a kombinasyon ed saray biyahe ed baybay na abagatan na Cebu.
highlights: Kawasan Falls a tuloy a antas
travel_tips: Magpareserba na canyoneering ed saray akreditado a operator
Mansuot na sapatos ed danum ya matibay so kapet
Mangrugi na kaaraw pian likayan so kadakelan na totoo
Ilugan so electronic ed saray supot a waterproof

intramuros.name: Intramuros (Manila)
intramuros.short_description: Makasaysayan a siyudad a pinalibotan na pader ed puso na kapitolyo na Filipinas.
intramuros.content: Say pinalibotan na pader a siyudad na Intramuros so sentro na tawir na Manila, ya saray dalan a bato et mangituloy ed Fort Santiago tan San Agustin Church, sakey a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
travel_tips: Maglakad o magbisikleta ed pader na kaaraw
Kombinaren ed bisita ed National Museum
Mansiansia parad saray cultural performance ed weekend
Usaren so ride-hailing app parad trapiko ed Manila

panglao.name: Panglao Island
panglao.short_description: Maputi a saray baybay tan panag-diving a pasingger ed Bohol.
panglao.content: Say Panglao et walaan na saray resort, baybay, tan akses ed panag-diving ed coral reef, ya say Alona Beach so panguuluan a pasinggeran parad panaglibot ed isla tan panagkakan ed paglubog na agew.
travel_tips: Manlipad ed Bohol-Panglao International Airport
Magpareserba na diving a maaga no bakasyon
Kombinaren ed Chocolate Hills ed sakey agew
Irespeto so saray marine protected area

apo-island.name: Apo Island
apo-island.short_description: Marine sanctuary ya bantog ed saray pawikan tan panag-snorkel.
apo-island.content: Say Apo Island et protektado a marine sanctuary ya saray pawikan et manlalangoy ed saray makulay a coral reef, ya maabot ed bangka manlapud Dumaguete o Dauin.
highlights: Saray lugar na panag-diving ed Dauin
travel_tips: Bayaran so marine sanctuary fee
Agsagiten iray pawikan o coral
Mangiyakar na snorkel gear o ag-abang ed site
Mangrugi na biyahe ed bangka a maaga pian mas natalna so dayat
